title: Worked Solution
text: To determine the probability of getting at least one tail and matching faces when flipping two fair coins, write out the full sample space $$\{HH, HT, TH, TT\}$$ and look for the intersection of both criteria. Out of the four equally likely outcomes, only $$\{TT\}$$ has both faces identical while containing at least one tail, giving $$\frac{1}{4}$$ or 0.25.
